subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for group @mention admission when mention `open_id` values are app-scoped?
rationale: The bug path is clear in source, but automation should not choose between union_id, cross-app open_id collection, app-perspective mapping, or a documented platform limitation without maintainer intent and Feishu API proof.

options.title: Prove And Land Stable Identity Matching
options.body: Use the linked PR or a replacement to implement a verified Feishu identity source, then add tests and live proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Document A Feishu Limitation
options.body: If Feishu does not expose a reliable bot identity across apps, keep the runtime conservative and document the supported workaround instead of adding a brittle matcher.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Multi-Bot Design
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers align it with Feishu session-scope and multi-bot routing work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/40194.

recommendation.title: Prove And Land Stable Identity Matching
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR or a replacement to implement a verified Feishu identity source, then add tests and live proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is Feishu-specific and the plugin metadata names this handle as the community maintenance owner for the bundled Feishu/Lark plugin.
